---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for RJ Nexus
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

> Please search [existing issues](https://github.com/rj-nexus/rj-nexus/issues) and [Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/rj-nexus/discussions) first, your idea may already exist.
> RJ Nexus is free and open source. Bigger or custom requests can also be discussed directly, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/rj-nexus/rj-nexus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#support-the-project).

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the problem or limitation you face. Example: "I can't show prayer times for more than one city on a page."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and short description of what you want to happen.

**What type of request is this?**
- [ ] New RJBuilder widget
- [ ] Improvement to an existing widget (name: ...)
- [ ] Admin panel or workflow
- [ ] Media manager
- [ ] Translation or new language
- [ ] Performance or SEO
- [ ] Theme or plugin system
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

**Where would it be used?**
- Page or admin section: [e.g. Admin → Posts → Edit, a public page, RJBuilder]
- Widget name (if any): [e.g. Share, Timeline]

**Design or examples**
Add screenshots, mockups or links to similar features on other sites. A rough sketch is enough.

**Alternatives you considered**
Other solutions or workarounds you tried, including plugins or custom code.

**Who benefits?**
- [ ] Most users (a general improvement)
- [ ] A specific kind of site (e.g. blog, business, news, religious or community site)
- [ ] Only my own project

**Environment (if relevant)**
- RJ Nexus version: [e.g. 1.11.1]
- PHP version: [e.g. 8.3]
- Where it runs: [local / shared hosting / VPS]

**Are you willing to help?**
- [ ] I can open a pull request
- [ ] I can test a beta version
- [ ] I can only suggest the idea

**Additional context**
Anything else that may help: deadlines, related issues, links.
